implementation: Lueming requires a genuinely other living target whose current equipment entity count is below the owner. One actual Play activation, no physical-card fee. Actual target owns a private complete1..13 rank choice; another actor cannot answer it. Native AI chooses7 without reading the draw pile.

Actual native JudgmentFrame has owner as judged participant and frozen parent/source/id/reason/result-binding. Native replacement and result observers run normally; final JudgmentResolvedEvent rank, not initial revealed rank or current entity appearance, decides the outcome.

Matched final rank issues one actual native two-damage attempt. Different rank randomly samples one currently obtainable HEJ entity, moves that exact entity to owner hand and drains real gain/loss children. Public custom gain fact contains only movement range/owner seats; the private stolen hand identity is retained only in trusted typed receipt and native movement privacy projection.

Historical Lueming count is actual Started facts by actual source owner across this game, surviving exact binding loss/regrant. Tunjun freezes that count at the once-game accepted activation, including zero; it never derives count from current cards, damage, turns or marker balance.

Each Tunjun iteration randomly samples a currently native-usable DrawPile equipment entity outside already used EquipmentSlots. It invokes the original beneficiary actor/provider native equipment use, including replacement and use observers; each original DrawPile-to-Processing entity payment and typed native return is checked once.

The owning receipt freezes chosen ranks, judge ID/final rank, gain entity/payment bounds, historical count, distinct subtype cursor and original equipment-use source/header. Nullable frame fields omit default null, and exposed subtype collection copies inputs.

Native Lueming judgment results join the existing public zhang-ji-rank card-set binding declared by the producer resource contract; normal FinishProgramSkill cleans only that actual result if it remains in Processing. Already claimed elsewhere results retain their real current zone.
interpretationsNotServerEvidence: Different equipment subtypes are the existing EquipmentCatalog.EquipmentSlot domains; different names in the same slot do not create extra Tunjun categories. A subtype can replace an already occupied recipient slot if native rules allow it.

Random selection follows current legal physical-card candidates at each actual iteration, not preselected phantom cards or future draw-pile positions. Read-only legal queries do not sample randomness.

Once the limited activation is paid, actual source-skill loss or initiator death does not cancel its remaining equipment sequence for the still-living beneficiary; terminal game or beneficiary death stops future issuance. This is a printed-rule inference authorized for this implementation, not a server grant-table or official FAQ observation.

An owner who actually dies cannot receive a future Lueming gain; a previously paid gain drains its children once. Damage already entitled by the final native judgment keeps its original source header.
